segments.say: Two nine-year-olds left a dead bird in his bed, and he knocked them both *flat*.
Jin Runcandel died at twenty-five, then woke up as a *baby*.
Now he is nine, locked in Storm Castle, and all he wants is a quiet *morning*.
Then his nanny Gilly walks in and *screams*.
A dead bird is lying in the middle of his *room*.
The culprits are his twin brothers, Heitona and *Deitona*.
They are nine years old, and they are *proud* of it.
In his past life, these two tormented him for *years*.
This time, Jin has a trick they have never *seen*.
Shadow force bursts out of his hands, and both brothers hit the *floor*.
He does not stop there. He drags them out into the *storm*.
And he leaves them in the freezing rain to *learn*.
But a guardian knight named Kahn saw *everything*.
He thinks Jin used forbidden *magic*, so he rides off to tell the clan.
Now the patriarch is marching to Storm Castle with two hundred *knights*.
The full story is on our channel.
